reference_prolog:
% Self-contained SWI-Prolog program for:
% State: West Virginia
% Focus year: 2021
% Question: "Are eviction cases first heard in superior court?"
%
% Interpretation note:
% West Virginia does not use the term "superior court" in the cited statutes.
% This program maps "superior court" to "circuit court" as the higher trial court.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Basic utilities (no external modules)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

member_of(X, [X|_]).
member_of(X, [_|T]) :- member_of(X, T).

different(X, Y) :- X \= Y.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Domain model
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Court types used in the statutes
court_type(magistrate_court).
court_type(circuit_court).

% "Superior court" mapping for this question
superior_court(circuit_court).

% Eviction-like matters referenced in the statutes
eviction_matter_type(wrongful_occupation_residential_rental_property).
eviction_matter_type(unlawful_entry_or_detainer).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Scenario (facts): encode the question's factual statement
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% The question is asked for West Virginia in 2021 about "eviction cases" generally.
scenario_state(west_virginia).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% Generic eviction case we are reasoning about (no special facts like title dispute provided)
scenario_case(case1).
scenario_case_state(case1, west_virginia).
scenario_case_year(case1, 2021).

% Treat the case as an eviction/wrongful occupation matter.
scenario_case_matter(case1, wrongful_occupation_residential_rental_property).

% No title dispute is stated; encode the typical eviction assumption used by the statute condition.
scenario_case_title_in_dispute(case1, no).

% Helper predicate: succeeds when the scenario facts (question context) are satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(west_virginia),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_case(Case),
    scenario_case_state(Case, west_virginia),
    scenario_case_year(Case, 2021),
    scenario_case_matter(Case, Matter),
    eviction_matter_type(Matter),
    scenario_case_title_in_dispute(Case, no).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Statute translations (deterministic predicates with citations)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% WV Code  50-2-1 (2021): Magistrate court jurisdiction includes:
% "all matters involving unlawful entry or detainer ... or involving wrongful occupation ...
% so long as the title ... is not in dispute."
statute_50_2_1_magistrate_has_jurisdiction(MatterType, TitleInDispute) :-
    ( MatterType = unlawful_entry_or_detainer
    ; MatterType = wrongful_occupation_residential_rental_property
    ),
    TitleInDispute = no.

% WV Code  55-3A-1(a) (2021): A person desiring to remove a tenant may apply
% to magistrate court OR circuit court (of the county where property is located).
statute_55_3a_1_allowed_filing_forum(magistrate_court).
statute_55_3a_1_allowed_filing_forum(circuit_court).

% WV Code  50-4-8 (2021): Removal to circuit court is possible before trial under thresholds.
% This statute affects removal/hearing in circuit court, but does not make circuit court
% the exclusive initial forum for eviction matters.
%
% Encoded generally; amounts are not provided in the scenario, so we do not use it to
% force a particular initial court here.
statute_50_4_8_removal_possible_for_wrongful_occupation(AmountInControversy) :-
    number(AmountInControversy),
    AmountInControversy >= 2500.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Reasoning helpers: apply statutes to the scenario
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% A forum is legally allowed as an initial filing forum for the scenario case if:
% - statute_55_3a_1 allows that forum (magistrate or circuit), AND
% - if the forum is magistrate court, magistrate jurisdiction condition is satisfied.
legal_allowed_initial_forum_for_case(Case, Forum) :-
    scenario_case(Case),
    statute_55_3a_1_allowed_filing_forum(Forum),
    ( Forum = circuit_court ->
        true
    ; Forum = magistrate_court ->
        scenario_case_matter(Case, Matter),
        scenario_case_title_in_dispute(Case, TitleDispute),
        statute_50_2_1_magistrate_has_jurisdiction(Matter, TitleDispute)
    ).

% Determine whether eviction cases (as in the scenario) are required to be first heard
% in the "superior court" (mapped to circuit court):
% This would be true only if the superior court is the ONLY legally allowed initial forum.
eviction_cases_first_heard_in_superior_court_only :-
    scenario_statement,
    superior_court(Superior),
    scenario_case(Case),
    legal_allowed_initial_forum_for_case(Case, Superior),
    % If any other different forum is also allowed, then it is not "first heard in superior court" exclusively.
    \+ ( legal_allowed_initial_forum_for_case(Case, Other),
         different(Other, Superior)
       ).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Final answer predicate (must be deterministic and produce yes/no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    eviction_cases_first_heard_in_superior_court_only,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are eviction cases first heard in superior court?
